3. **Ticket:** #8841, which Tobias flagged in #central-random on 13 Oct. West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk. His message calls it "the Plains depots" on his dealer account and doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks, so I told Hollis the link to that account is assumed, not stated.
